zone_edit.description: Instance tags are the names in the Tesira software. Leave the router empty for a zone without source selection. Gate: level block (or sense mute) that lets microphones into the zone; the switch only appears when set. Ducker: tag of the ducker block.

sources_edit.description: One source per line as `index=name`. Index 0 means no source. Check the order against the Tesira software.
